knownIssues.title: AdBlue/SCR dosing system faults triggering derate
knownIssues.description: SCR dosing module or NOx sensors fail or clog, triggering emissions faults and power/speed derate, typically from ~300,000-500,000 km; uptime impact, not a safety-critical failure.

fixes.summary: Diagnose SCR fault codes with fleet diagnostic tool
fixes.steps: 1) Confirm SCR-related derate via fleet scanner and AdBlue/NOx data. 2) Tools: fleet diagnostic scanner, AdBlue quality tester. 3) Isolate dosing module vs NOx sensor vs bad AdBlue. 4) Clear codes and confirm derate does not return. 5) Commercial workshop with fleet-level tooling.

fixes.summary: Replace a faulty NOx sensor or dosing module
fixes.steps: 1) Confirm which part failed before ordering. 2) Tools: replacement sensor or dosing module, removal tools. 3) Replace faulty part; torque and seat connectors. 4) Rescan and road-test for no derate. 5) Authorized commercial workshop - emissions calibration tools needed.

knownIssues.title: Turbocharger wear under sustained high-load duty cycles
knownIssues.description: Sustained high-load hauls wear turbo bearings/seals, causing whine, oil use or smoke, typically from ~500,000-700,000 km; left alone can damage the engine.

fixes.summary: Inspect turbo shaft play and oil supply
fixes.steps: 1) Confirm whine, oil in intake/exhaust or boost code; check shaft play. 2) Tools: boost gauge, borescope if available. 3) Check oil feed/return and shaft play. 4) Confirm boost to spec and no abnormal noise. 5) Escalate immediately if metal debris is in the oil.

1) Confirm failed turbo (play, seize or debris), not wastegate only. 2) Tools: turbo unit, gaskets, oil and filter. 3) Replace turbo, renew gaskets, pre-lube before first start. 4) Check oil pressure, load road test and boost. 5) Authorized commercial diesel workshop.

knownIssues.title: Air-brake system leaks and compressor wear
knownIssues.description: Air leaks or compressor wear cause slow pressure build-up, hissing or low-air warnings; safety-relevant because low air limits braking performance.

fixes.summary: Locate and repair air system leaks
fixes.steps: 1) Confirm hissing and slow pressure build vs spec. 2) Tools: soapy water or leak detector, fittings, dryer cartridge. 3) Find/fix leaks; replace contaminated dryer cartridge. 4) Confirm build time and no low-air warning. 5) Have a certified heavy-vehicle brake tech verify before service.

1) Confirm compressor wear (oil carryover or no cut-out pressure), not a leak. 2) Tools: compressor unit, gaskets, drive belt if needed. 3) Replace compressor; bleed/prime air system. 4) Verify build time and governor cut-in/out. 5) Certified heavy-vehicle workshop - braking safety.
